name: Phase Gate Validation
description: Enforces the phase gate and state-file update after a task completes

then.prompt: Phase gate check. 1) Run the track build command (Java: mvn clean compile -f Hospital_Servlet1/pom.xml, .NET: dotnet build). 2) If it fails, fix the errors and re-run before doing anything else. 3) Once green, update Migration/.migration-state.json — mark the current phase complete and the next phase in_progress. 4) Continue immediately to the next phase without asking permission.
